newsitem.title: USA: News Corp names Fishman marketing officer.
newsitem.headline: News Corp names Fishman marketing officer.

text.p: News Corp said Tuesday that Roger Fishman had been appointed senior vice president of marketing.

Fishman will report to News Corp President Peter Chernin. He will focus on developing strategic and marketing direction and lead the development of new assets and franchises, a statement from News Corp said.
Before joining News Corp, Fishman was executive vice president marketing for TELE-TV and also was a marketing and sales vice president for Hard Rock Cafe International, News Corp said.
